title: Operator acceptance store
description: Committed record of human operator sign-offs that waive operator-row work at the merge gate. Written only by the owner-gated `accept` CLI (never by an autonomous agent). One allowlist loader is the SSOT for `owner`. Shape-vs-policy split: this schema validates SHAPE only; policy rules (reason >= 5 chars, date parses as a real date, owner in allowlist) are enforced by the gates.

item.description: work-item id, e.g. ITEM-123 — adjust the pattern to your id scheme

owner.description: MUST be on the acceptance-owners allowlist (gate-enforced)

items.description: the operator-handoff ids waived, or a single 'all'

date.description: policy: gates require it to parse as a real date

method.description: how the human confirmed — e.g. 'interactive' or an explicit-flag marker; free string so a CLI-flag rename never invalidates committed data
